campaignOnboarding.title: Run a one-shot from here
campaignOnboarding.intro: {{done}} of {{total}} core steps ready. Follow the next action from invite through recap, or open the checklist for the whole path.
campaignOnboarding.homebrewNote: Homebrew mode is active: no ruleset compendium is required for this path.

paused.title: One-shot guide paused
paused.body: {{done}} of {{total}} core steps were ready when you paused it.

complete.title: Your one-shot runway is ready
complete.body: You have a party, adventure seed, encounter, rewards, and a recap lane. Keep refining modules as needed.

announcements.skipped: One-shot guide skipped. Resume it from the dashboard any time.
announcements.soloEnabled: Solo mode selected. Invitations are skipped for this campaign guide.

rules.homebrewBody: No rule system is selected. Use manual DCs, stat blocks, and rulings; the one-shot path still works.
rules.rulesetBody: A ruleset is attached to this campaign, so compendium and encounter helpers can use it.

ai.title: AI helper optional
ai.todoBody: AI-DM is available if you want a solo or assisted table, but it is not required for the one-shot path.
ai.doneBody: AI-DM is enabled for this campaign and can help run or draft parts of the session.

compendium.title: الموسوعة ready
compendium.body: Use the campaign ruleset's compendium when you need monsters, items, or reference text.

invite.title: Invite the table
invite.body: Create a player or viewer invite so the group can join the campaign before play.
invite.unknownBody: Checking the member roster. If this is a solo or AI-assisted one-shot, you can skip invitations.

party.title: Add the party
party.body: Add at least one active character so encounters, HP, XP, and loot have somewhere to land.

adventure.title: Create a quest or starting location
adventure.body: Give the one-shot a clear objective or place to begin before building combat.

encounter.title: Prep the encounter
encounter.body: Create the first fight or challenge and link it to the quest, location, or session when helpful.

rewards.title: Stage rewards and XP
rewards.body: Track loot, coins, XP, or level progress so the finish line is ready before the dice hit the table.

recap.title: Write the recap
recap.body: After the one-shot, publish a recap so players have a shared record and next hook.
